title: CAN-SPAM Penalties: Up to $53,088 an Email, and Who Can Sue
meta_description: The FTC can seek up to $53,088 per email that breaks CAN-SPAM, states up to $250 and ISPs up to $100. Its 2024 record under the Act was a $2.95 million penalty.
secondary_keywords: can you sue for spam emails

image.takeaway: The FTC can seek up to $53,088 per violating email. In 2024 it called $2.95 million its record CAN-SPAM penalty.
image.alt: CAN-SPAM penalties: the FTC can seek up to $53,088 for each email that violates the Act, state attorneys general up to $250 per unlawful email to their residents and internet access services up to $100 or $25 an email; in August 2024 the FTC called its $2.95 million Verkada penalty the largest it had obtained under CAN-SPAM
